create.name: Nikki Dyer
create.bio:
Nikki Dyer is a meditation guide and certified life coach in Salt Lake City, Utah, who works under the name Coached By Nikki Dyer. She came to both meditation and coaching after they reshaped her own life, and she later added training informed by hypnotherapy. A mother of two daughters, she writes and records her own guided meditations and shares them freely on YouTube and Insight Timer, where she has taught since early 2023.

Much of her recorded work follows the sky: a new practice for each new and full moon, named for the sign it falls in, alongside sessions for the solstices and equinoxes, short morning practices, gratitude and affirmations. Her style is gentle and conversational, asking listeners to notice their thoughts and feelings rather than push them away, and to change what they can while making peace with what they cannot. One-to-one, she offers 60-minute Sage Advice sessions over Zoom focused on goals, patterns and relationships, and she leads themed group meditation evenings for yoga studios and groups of friends, with topics such as new moon intentions, full moon release, chakras and self-love.

courses.title: Sage Advice: A 60-Minute Single Session
courses.description: A one-hour coaching call on Zoom to name what you want to change, look at the patterns that keep you circling, and leave with a few simple tools to use straight away. It also works as a trial before longer coaching.

courses.title: Group Meditation Experiences
courses.description: An in-person evening of guided meditation for a yoga studio or a group of friends, built around a theme you choose. Past themes include new moon intentions, a full moon cleanse, chakras, gratitude and self-love. Booked by email.

courses.title: The Spiritual Gym: Small Changes That Change Everything
courses.description: A seven-day Insight Timer course pairing a short meditation with a written message and a journaling prompt each day. The days cover intentions, gratitude, confidence, dropping excuses, picturing your future and forgiveness.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

courses.title: Stories That Stick: Guided Story Meditations For Clarity & Personal Growth
courses.description: Five meditations of about ten minutes, one a day, each built around a short story or metaphor meant to help you see an old situation from a fresh angle.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

free_resources.title: Nikki Dyer on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Short guided meditations for mornings, gratitude and self-love, along with practices for each new and full moon. The single tracks are free to hear.

flags: Mainly a life and relationship coach with a hypnotherapy-informed session; the spiritual side is her moon and astrology meditations, chakra themes and group meditation evenings. A human may want to check the fit.
Salt Lake City comes from her Insight Timer profile; her site does not name a city. Availability set to local_online because she offers in-person group evenings plus Zoom sessions.
Her own-site photos (blonde, curly hair) match her YouTube avatar; a dark-haired woman also pictured on the site (testimonial/Instagram screenshot) was not used.
Sage Advice price not shown publicly (Calendly page renders without it); set to Contact for pricing.
Group Meditation Experiences has no page of its own (booked by email), so it links to her home page.

YouTube video views could not be sorted by popularity; videos picked from her most recent uploads, preferring evergreen themes. Several titles name a 2026 moon or season; they are recordings, kept as titled.
Insight Timer bio could only be partly quoted by WebFetch; her site text (rendered by script) was extracted and used for the bio check.
